column1: # Split-wrapper durations refreshed from https://github.com/ruby-dlee/firstmate/actions/runs/30681093133 on 2026-08-01 UTC.
# Teardown wrapper starting weights split the 642448 ms whole-suite measurement from https://github.com/ruby-dlee/firstmate/actions/runs/30681622585.
# Account-routing four-way starting weights split the 828294 ms A and 729062 ms B measurements from https://github.com/ruby-dlee/firstmate/actions/runs/31341755649.
# Teardown A/B, secondmate safety, and arm-pretool weights were refreshed from completed tests in https://github.com/ruby-dlee/firstmate/actions/runs/31346291648 on 2026-08-10 UTC.
# Completed branch test weights were refreshed from exact manifests in https://github.com/ruby-dlee/firstmate/actions/runs/31348970504 on 2026-08-10 UTC.
# tests/fm-crosscheck.test.sh was remeasured on 2026-08-07 after that suite grew from 40 to 60 cases, replacing its recorded 75707 ms.

# Method: serial bracketed local runs at pipeline head c02248ab timed the subject at 178788 ms and 181014 ms around reference tests/fm-checkout-refresh.test.sh at 907786 ms against its recorded 475500 ms.
# Subject drift between the two bracketing runs was 1.2 percent, which is the evidence that the derived ratio is trustworthy rather than merely plausible.

# Scaling by the derived factor 1.909 into the GitHub Actions units this file uses gives the recorded 94232 ms; raw local numbers were deliberately not written because the measuring machine averaged load 23-29 and would have been incomparable with the other 97 rows.
